title: Come Back & Come Over
situation: Leaving the work area and coming back to help a teammate.
objective: Use come back and come over to talk about returning and approaching someone.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes I leave the work area to get a tool.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang saya meninggalkan area kerja untuk mengambil alat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I always come back quickly because the machine needs my attention.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya selalu kembali dengan cepat karena mesin membutuhkan perhatian saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If a machine stops, my teammate calls me and says, 'Can you come over here?'
dialogue.indonesian: Jika mesin berhenti, rekan kerja saya menelepon dan berkata, 'Bisa datang ke sini?'

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I come over, look at the problem, and we check it together.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya datang menghampiri, melihat masalahnya, dan kami memeriksanya bersama.

learningNotes: come back berarti kembali ke tempat semula.
come over berarti datang ke tempat orang lain berada.
Perhatikan polanya: come back to the work area, come over here.
